Laggoni Dass vs The District Collector, on 19 October, 2023
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Mummineni Sudheer Kumar
 Writ Petition No.20943 of 2013
Order:

entities.text: Laggoni Dass vs The District Collector
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This writ petition is filed questioning the notice No.D/1309/2012, dated 27.01.2013 under Section 5A of Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (for short, 'the Act, 1894') proposing to acquire the subject house properties situated at Ghatkesar for the purpose of laying road over bridge across Ghatkesar to Shameerpet road, as illegal and arbitrary.

2. Respondent No.2 initiated the land acquisition proceedings for the purpose of construction of road over bridge and proposed to acquire the subject properties belonging to the petitioners by issuing a preliminary notification under Section 4(1) of the Act, 1894 in proceedings No.G2/13057/2011, dated 28.12.2012.
During the process of said acquisition, aggrieved by issuance of a notice under Section 5A of Act, 1894, the petitioners approached this Court by filing the present writ petition.
3. This Court has not passed any interim order in this writ petition.
Hence, further proceedings have taken place pursuant to the said preliminary notification and an award was passed in MSK,J proceedings Lr.No.D/1309/2012, dated 31.03.2015.

However, in respect of the subject properties it is stated as under:
"43.
In response to the notification, the following individuals have filed writ petition in W.P.No.20943/2013 against the proposed acquisition and obtained interim orders of statusquo.
Subsequently though the court orders are not specific barring the Land Acquisition Officer for processing the acquisition, the writ petitioners have not filed any claims.

Hence compensation could not be determined thorugh notified against the following properties."
4.

In the light of the above, the proceedings that were initiated under the provisions of Act, 1894 read with the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short, 'the Act, 2013') are required to be passed within a period of two years from the date of declaration published under Section 6 of the Act, 1894.

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: But, as is evident from the Award dated 31.03.2015, and the submissions made by the learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition, there is no Award passed in respect of subject properties.
5. In view of the same, the entire proceedings that were initiated by issuing the preliminary notification, dated 28.12.2012, have lapsed.

Hence, the cause in the writ petition does not survive and in case if the respondents intend to acquire the subject properties, they are at liberty to do so and MSK,J initiate fresh acquisition proceedings under the provisions of the Act, 2013.
